Use case: style-transfer for a production mobile-game victory BACKGROUND TEXTURE. Image 1 is the edit target: the approved text-free celadon feast dialog. Image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for the game's “市井朱红” theme. Make one matching red-lacquer themed victory dialog background, retaining EXACTLY image 1's portrait aspect ratio, composition, object placement and all blank live-text areas.

Reskin the frame and pot to rich Chinese festive red lacquer, deep emerald accents and ornate brushed antique-gold edges, matching the red shop-sign and dark emerald atmosphere of image 2. Main copy area remains bright warm ivory/champagne, with high text contrast. Large PRIMARY BUTTON near the bottom becomes glossy vermilion RED lacquer with gold rim and elegant cloud scrolls. Secondary button remains warm ivory with gold trim; result strip is a very pale warm-gold wash. The lavish hotpot remains in the upper half with a luxurious emerald-and-antique-gold pot, ornamental gold handles, a lively fan of beef rolls, vegetables, lotus root, shrimp, and the same highly recognizable precious ingredients: sapphire BLUE lobster left, spiny RED KING CRAB legs/claw right, MATSUTAKE left foreground, BLACK TRUFFLE and marbled slices right foreground. Preserve the three gold stars, golden broth splashes, steam, light rays and abundant celebratory impact. Elegant polished hand-painted 2D casual game art with gently dimensional food. NOT a restaurant poster or different screen.

All panel geometry must stay precisely aligned with image 1: upper feast occupying the top ~52%, blank title/subtitle region ~52–64%, blank pale result strip ~65–72%, primary button ~74–84%, secondary button ~86–95%. Keep the same spacious blank text region, blank caption area at the top, and both blank button interiors. DO NOT render ANY letters, numbers, Chinese characters, text, labels, watermarks, icons in text areas, additional controls or close buttons. No phone frame, no collage. Return only one entire finished text-free background texture.
prompts.4:
Use case: style-transfer for a production mobile-game victory BACKGROUND TEXTURE. Image 1 is the edit target: the approved text-free celadon feast dialog. Image 2 is the existing game's “奶油黏土” STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Reskin image 1 into that charming cream-clay theme, preserving its EXACT portrait aspect ratio and all interface geometry, object positions and blank text areas.

Use soft sculpted polymer clay / high-quality cozy casual game 2.5D rendering, rounded puffy forms, matte buttery cream and apricot edges, sage/leaf-green accents and warm soft shadows. The entire rounded panel has a thick warm cream/apricot clay frame instead of ornate metal corners. The pot is a luxurious but friendly plump sage-green glazed/clay pot with warm creamy apricot handles, small restrained floral relief. Three puffy golden-cookie-like stars and warm celebratory rays, curled steam, small confetti and glossy golden broth splashes remain. The abundant food stays in the same upper-half arrangement, adapted into appetizing tactile clay forms: sapphire blue lobster left, red king crab legs/claw right, stout matsutake and sliced black truffle front, red-white beef rolls, shrimp, lotus root, tofu, leafy vegetables. Premium ingredient identities clearly readable; sophisticated playful food art, not characters with faces.

The primary button stays in exactly the same lower position, becoming a thick rounded leaf-green clay button with cream/apricot raised rim and subtle rounded corner decoration. Secondary button is warm cream clay with pale apricot rim; stat strip is a very pale soft pistachio/cream inset pill. Keep the large central text region light warm ivory and empty. Keep original layout: feast top ~52%, EMPTY title/subtitle region ~52–64%, EMPTY stat strip ~65–72%, EMPTY primary button ~74–84%, EMPTY secondary button ~86–95%, EMPTY caption area at top center.

Absolutely NO text, Chinese characters, numbers, letter-like symbols, watermarks, logos, close/X buttons or extra controls. Preserve original touch-target locations and all negative space. One clean finished full dialog background texture, no device frame, mockup board or collage.
prompts.8:
Edit this approved mobile game victory-dialog design into a production-ready BACKGROUND TEXTURE for the same UI. Keep EXACTLY the same canvas aspect, full frame, composition and geometry. Preserve the entire feast illustration (blue lobster, red king crab legs, matsutake, black truffle, beef rolls, vegetables, ornate celadon pot), the three gold stars, steam and confetti, all gold/celadon ornamental edges, ivory background and bamboo motif. Preserve the sizes and exact positions of the pale-green stat strip, large jade-green primary button and ivory secondary button, including shadows, gilded rims and corner patterns. There is no close button and none should be added.

ONLY REMOVE EVERY TEXT GLYPH from this image and smoothly reconstruct the original material beneath each glyph: erase the top “开锅大吉”, main title “第1关完成”, subtitle, text inside stat strip, text inside both buttons. Leave those exact same areas completely blank, clean and spacious; actual text will be rendered live in game code. Do not invent substitute symbols or text, don't move/enlarge/shrink any object or button, don't fill blank copy space with decoration. This must look like the approved design with its typography layer hidden. No watermark, no characters, no UI additions. One complete portrait background image, NOT a sheet or device mockup.
prompts.9:
Use case: style-transfer for a production mobile-game victory BACKGROUND TEXTURE. Image 1 is the edit target: an approved text-free jade celebration dialog. Image 2 is the existing game's “宣纸朱印” STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create a matching ink-and-vermilion Chinese rice-paper themed version, preserving the EXACT original portrait aspect ratio, positions, UI geometry and all blank text fields.

A refined warm ivory rice-paper panel with subtle visible paper fibers, thin antique-brass rectangular-rounded border, restrained painted cloud-scroll corners, understated dark-brown ink and vermilion accents. In peripheral upper corners introduce very faint ink bamboo / plum details, softly hand-painted, never occupying text areas. The feast remains exuberant, lush and dimensional with a delicate hand-painted Chinese illustration finish: ornate pale ivory-and-bronze pot with subtle dark ink lotus motifs and antique brass handles; recognizable sapphire BLUE lobster on left, RED spiny king crab sections/claw on right, stout matsutake at left foreground, black truffle and marbled slices at right foreground, plus beef rolls, shrimp, lotus root, tofu and green vegetables. Preserve three champagne-gold stars and warm rays, swirling off-white steam and golden broth splashes. Premium and festive yet consistent with the existing paper-and-red-seal game theme. Do NOT add any actual seal characters or writing.

The main title/subtitle area is empty pale warm paper. The result strip is a soft very pale parchment/sand color with fine brass border. Primary button is rich vermilion lacquer RED with delicate brass trim and subtle painted cloud patterns. Secondary button is ivory paper with warm brass border and faint cloud ornament. Keep exactly the original locations: feast top ~52%, BLANK title/subtitle area ~52–64%, BLANK stat strip ~65–72%, BLANK primary button ~74–84%, BLANK secondary button ~86–95%, BLANK top caption region between the two short gold lines. All center fields have good contrast for real live text.

STRICTLY NO Chinese characters, text, numbers, logos, watermarks, seals with writing, X/close buttons or extra controls. No phone or mockup board. One full finished text-free background texture, not a collage.
